arxiv-2205-01735.title: Substructure, supernovae, and a time-resolved star formation history for Upper Scorpius 2023 Substructure, supernovae, and a time-resolved star formation history for Upper Scorpius – 12
arxiv-2205-01735.creator: Geovanny Briceño-Morales, Julio Chanamé
arxiv-2205-01735.description: Abstract The improved astrometry precision of Gaia-eDR3 allows us to perform a detailed study of the Upper Scorpius OB association and revisit its spatial, kinematic, and age substructure. We achieve this by combining clustering techniques and complementing with age estimations based on Gaia photometry. Our census retrieves 3661 candidate members for Upper Scorpius with contamination ∼ \sim 9%.

arxiv-2211-00115.title: Textless direct speech-to-speech translation with discrete speech representation
arxiv-2211-00115.creator: Xinjian Li, Ye Jia, Chung-Cheng Chiu
arxiv-2211-00115.description: Abstract Research on speech-to-speech translation (S2ST) has progressed rapidly in recent years. Many end-to-end systems have been proposed and show advantages over conventional cascade systems, which are often composed of recognition, translation and synthesis sub-systems. However, most of end-to-end systems still rely on intermediate textual supervision during training, which makes it infeasible to work for languages without written forms.

arxiv-2306-01157.title: Delphic Offline Reinforcement Learning under Nonidentifiable Hidden Confounding
arxiv-2306-01157.creator: Alizée Pace, Hugo Yèche, Bernhard Schölkopf, Gunnar Rätsch, Guy Tennenholtz
arxiv-2306-01157.description: Abstract A prominent challenge of offline reinforcement learning (RL) is the issue of hidden confounding: unobserved variables may influence both the actions taken by the agent and the observed outcomes. Hidden confounding can compromise the validity of any causal conclusion drawn from data and presents a major obstacle to effective offline RL.

arxiv-2306-09544.title: Building blocks for complex tasks: Robust generative event extraction for radiology reports under domain shifts
arxiv-2306-09544.creator: Sitong Zhou, Meliha Yetisgen, Mari Ostendorf
arxiv-2306-09544.description: Abstract This paper explores methods for extracting information from radiology reports that generalize across exam modalities to reduce requirements for annotated data. We demonstrate that multi-pass T5-based text-to-text generative models exhibit better generalization across exam modalities compared to approaches that employ BERT-based task-specific classification layers.

arxiv-2306-12827.title: Boundedness of spectral projectors on hyperbolic surfaces
arxiv-2306-12827.creator: Jean-Philippe Anker, Pierre Germain and Tristan Léger
arxiv-2306-12827.description: Abstract . In this paper, we prove L 2 → L p L^{2}\to L^{p} estimates, where p > 2 p>2 , for spectral projectors on a wide class of hyperbolic surfaces. More precisely, we consider projections in small spectral windows [ λ − η , λ + η ] [\lambda-\eta,\lambda+\eta] on geometrically finite hyperbolic surfaces of infinite volume.

arxiv-2405-11589.title: Magnetic field dragging in filamentary molecular clouds
arxiv-2405-11589.creator: Domitilla Tapinassi, Daniele Galli, Marco Padovani, Henrik Beuther
arxiv-2405-11589.description: Abstract Context. Maps of polarized dust emission of molecular clouds reveal the morphology of the magnetic field associated with star-forming regions. In particular, polarization maps of hub-filament systems show the distortion of magnetic field lines induced by gas flows onto and inside filaments. Aims.

Often co-formulated in commercial energy drinks, they are widely regarded as the two principal bioactive compounds. However, findings regarding their combined efficacy remain inconclusive.

pmc-12541661.title: Survival benefits in non-small cell lung cancer during the immune checkpoint inhibitor era: integrating lymph node burden for prognostic precision
pmc-12541661.creator: Yuntao Feng, Qijue Lu, Yichen Dong, Jingyu Chen, Yue Zhao, Long Xu, Junqi Wu, Bowen Shi, Deping Zhao
pmc-12541661.description: BackgroundLung cancer remains a global health challenge, with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) comprising the majority of cases. Since 2015, immunotherapy, specifically immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs), has significantly shifted treatment paradigms in advanced NSCLC, yet the prognostic role of lymph node metastatic burden remains underexplored.

pmc-12649336.title: Antibiotic Resistance in Urinary Pathogens Among Kidney Transplant Recipients: A Persistent Threat
pmc-12649336.creator: Büşra Çalışır, Abdullah İbrahim Çalışır, Oktay Rodoplu, Abdulmecit Yıldız, Alparslan Ersoy, Cüneyt Özakın, Phumzile P Skosana, Filippo Mariano
pmc-12649336.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background: Urinary tract infections (UTIs) are the most common infections after kidney transplantation and significantly affect patient outcomes. In these immunosuppressed patients, antibiotic resistance is of particular concern due to recurrent infections and limited treatment options. The aim of this study was to evaluate the distribution of microorganisms isolated from urine cultures of kidney transplant patients and to assess their antimicrobial susceptibility patterns. Methods: This retrospective study included all adult kidney transplant recipients with positive urine cultures during 2023–2024.

pmc-12687392.description: Appendiceal endometriosis is an uncommon manifestation of extrapelvic endometriosis that can clinically and radiologically mimic acute appendicitis. We report the case of a 41-year-old woman who presented with acute right lower quadrant abdominal pain and laboratory findings suggestive of appendicitis.

pmc-13613415.description: Pentosan polysulfate sodium (PPS) is a glycosaminoglycan mimic that is the only current active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) for the oral treatment of interstitial cystitis.
